preamble: Editorial still-life photography on a seamless warm off-white cyclorama. Large soft overhead source, huge white bounce, near-shadowless with one soft contact shadow. High key, gentle contrast, warm white and pale neutral grade. Medium-format sharpness, fine grain. Photographic realism, no CGI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: An open lined school exercise book lying on a pale warm off-white desk, seen from slightly above at a three-quarter angle, a dark blue fountain pen resting across its right page, two closed notebooks with plain pastel covers and a wooden pencil beside it. The whole group sits in the lower right third of the frame; the left two thirds of the frame are the empty smooth warm off-white desk surface for text. Soft daylight from the upper left, one soft contact shadow. Pages completely blank, no handwriting, no letters, no numbers, no text, no logos, no hands, no people.
